# Historical static regression oracles

These text files preserve the complete original test sources at immutable base
`16655b0bbc0065d03ab1c040f0b1a5f267649d69` (`v0.1.11`). They are provenance,
not collected tests, supported wire readers, or current acceptance evidence.

The chart/filter SVG assertions, startup/retry cases, uneven frozen-history
selection, multivalued-parameter comparisons and `rel=1e-9` tolerances remain
verbatim. Current active tests assert the schema-1 and publication refusals.
They do not claim current browser, chart or numerical parity. Scientific result
publication remains closed; the data-free status page is covered separately by
`tests/test_site_unavailable.py`.

eligible evidence and exact task/metric/unit/fold/variant selection. Neither
history conversion nor synthetic metadata declarations establish that evidence.
Do not copy missing scientific context into the frozen source to obtain parity.
